Netflix announces upcoming animation slate including anime remake

Netflix has revealed its upcoming animation slate, featuring titles such as 'One Piece', 'Ray Gunn', and 'Ghostbusters'. The announcement includes details about an awaited anime remake of Eiichiro Oda's classic manga, 'The One Piece', which is set to premiere in February 2027 with a visual overhaul by WIT Studio.
